text:
maria: Quick sync: need a stripped-down bench narrative for the launch post + short webinar. Goal: crisp hero stat, 3 visual assets, and clear inbound routing. low-verbosity copy. who volunteers?

devin: Ill take the hero stat + headline. Thinking: one short sentence that ties tail latency to $$/1k token. Then a single-line explanation pointing to appendix.

oli: I'll mock the visuals: 1) split hero (latency vs cost), 2) prompt-family breakdown, 3) routing diagram. Want to do a textured two-tone to separate latency (cool) vs cost (warm).

harper: On messaging: avoid superlatives. Use "typical p50/p95" and call out sample size. Two short CTAs: "Try Hosted (fast)" and "Request Dedicated (predictable)". Add an option for partners.

benchbot: Latest run (2024-09-07): hosted p50=140ms p95=480ms; dedicated p50=100ms p95=230ms; cost_norm = hosted $0.028 / 1k tok; dedicated $0.018 / 1k tok; prompt families: short(<=48), mid(512), long(2048). CSV: /internal/bench/mini-launch/2024-09-07.csv

maria: Good. devin, can you turn cost_norm into the hero line: "~35% lower unit cost on Dedicated vs Hosted at typical enterprise loads"? be careful with the percent wording.

devin: I can do "Dedicated: $0.018 /1k vs Hosted: $0.028 /1k (example workload)." then a micro-cta: "See appendix for prompts & env."

oli: Visual notes for hero chart:
```
- Left panel: p50 & p95 lines across model/configs (quantized variants as dotted)
- Right panel: stacked bars = $/1k by prompt family (short/mid/long)
- Annotate demo prompt used in webinar (mid-length summarize)
```

sam: I'll map that into a 20-minute webinar: 3 min problem, 6 min benchmark insights (hero + chart), 6 min demo, 5 min Q&A. Need exact demo numbers for timing.

harper: Landing form plan: one radio for "I want to self-serve" vs "I need dedicated capacity". If they pick dedicated, require a short textbox for monthly tokens and primary model family. Tag leads with utm_source=webinar_spark.

maria: Small compliance note: add footnote "results based on N=500 requests across 3 runs; see appendix for variance." No absolute claims beyond test.

benchbot: Added appendix: /internal/bench/mini-launch/2024-09-07-appendix.md (includes raw latencies, run IDs, hardware: A100-80GB, runtime v2.4.1).

devin: Copy drafts for A/B test on registration page:
A) "Ship features with predictable latency and lower unit cost."
B) "Reduce inference spend while keeping fast responses."
Which one leans more enterprise? B sounds value-first.

oli: Design needs the figma frames by EOD Thurs. I'll annotate the hero with alt text and color tokens.

sam: For the demo I want a repeatable script: spin up hosted vs dedicated, run the mid prompt 10x, show p95 delta live, then show cost calc slide. Can we precompute numbers so demo doesn't fail if env fluctuates?

benchbot: Precomputed sample for demo (mid prompt): hosted mean p95=460ms; dedicated mean p95=220ms; cost per 1k tokens as above. Use these as the canonical demo numbers.

maria: Action items + deadlines:
- devin: hero copy + exact $/1k figs, and micro-headline A/B (EOD Wed)
- oli: hero + two supporting visuals, figma frames (EOD Thurs)
- sam: demo script + precomputed numbers in slide (Fri AM)
- harper: landing form + routing rules + UTM (Fri AM)
- benchbot/eng: appendix + raw csv (done)

devin: I'll include the brief footnote language about sample size and environment.

oli: Also will provide a simplified PNG for social posts (square) and a full slide PNG.

maria: Nice. Last nit: make hero headline short enough for tweet copy. aim for 70 characters or fewer.

harper: We'll also add a tiny checkbox on registration: "Share my typical token volume" to help SDRs qualify.

maria: Thanks team  I'll compile a 1-page launch brief tomorrow with links to figma and appendix. :sparkles:
